description.value: You create a storm of duplicates of yourself and swing, stab, or shoot them in a cone, line, or emanation. Choose a 30-foot cone, 10-foot emanation, or 60-foot line. Creatures in the area take damage equal to your weapon damage dice, plus one additional weapon damage die, without any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers. They each attempt a basic Reflex save against the higher of your class DC and spell DC. A creature who critically fails their save takes any critical specialization effect and extra deadly or fatal damage, similarly to if you critically hit them.
